hiker.name: Hiker
dialog: The riders up on the Cycling Road never look down. They don't know what they're missing.
There's a cave mouth tucked away under the bridge that most of them have never even seen.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Cyclist Axel: Brakes are for people who don't want to battle! Pikachu, go!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Cyclist Axel: Maybe I should have used the brakes after all. Ride safely, won't you?

trainer.dialogueBefore: Cyclist Megan: My Staravia races me along this bridge every day. Today it can race you!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Cyclist Megan: At least Staravia is still faster than both of us. That's something.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Cyclist James: My Ponyta gallops beside my front wheel all the way down the road. Can you keep up?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Cyclist James: Outpaced! Ponyta's mane is still flickering from the effort.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Cyclist Nicole: One Starly, two Starly, three Starly! Count them as they fly at you!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Cyclist Nicole: They'll be Staravia one day, all three of them. Then we'll see!

trainer.dialogueBefore: Cyclist John: I ride this road from end to end every morning, and you're in my lane!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Cyclist John: All right, all right. The road's wide enough for the two of us.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Cyclist Kayla: Hold it right there! Let's see whose Pokémon is quicker off the mark!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Cyclist Kayla: Yours, it seems. My Pikachu wants a rematch already.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Cyclist Ryan: My Shinx gives off sparks every time we go over a bump. Want to feel one?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Cyclist Ryan: Ow, my hair's standing on end. Was that your doing or Shinx's?

trainer.dialogueBefore: Cyclist Rachel: The gate's just ahead, but a battle comes first! My Pokémon are raring to go!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Cyclist Rachel: That was over quickly. I'd better pump up my tyres and try again.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Hiker Theodore: Bikes rattle over that bridge all day, but down here it's just me and my Onix. Let's rumble!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Hiker Theodore: Hah! You hit like a rockfall. My Onix needs a lie-down.
